entry.title: Ask HN: I miss old days of blogging without promotions (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
entry.summary: I miss days when people were writing articles to share what they have learned, people are still doing it, but signal to noise ratio increased so much that it feels like most articles are to promote something, either promote their product, or promote their personal brand or just get more traffic to their website to sell ads. What's even worse, a lot of those articles are generated by AI, I just dont want to spend even 15 seconds to read it. Problem is, it is also difficult to detect if it is written by AI or not. Where are the genuine knowledge sharing, human written blogs? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48663180 Points: 1 # Comments: 1

entry.title: Show HN: ccMarvin - Just Email with AI (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
entry.summary: Backstory: My name is Michael Stoppelman, I'm a super angel (300+ investments, I've invested in YC companies like Vanta, Flexport, Biorender, Permitflow and Canary Technologies). Prior to that I built and ran the engineering team at Yelp. I thought there was a missing piece to the LLMs where they couldn't talk via email which is where as an investor I work all day. So I built ccMarvin so I could forward emails for summaries, I could get legal feedback on SAFEs or other transactional emails, I could get newsletters on sectors like AI / Space or specific folks I want to follow. I don't like to use X because I end up getting to sucked in and waste time doom scrolling, I rather get a newsletter. So I'm announcing ccMarvin: a service you can just email at marvin@ccmarvin.com. It's like emailing a very smart research analyst or chief of staff that's connected to all the LLMs (Gemini / Claude / ChatGPT & xAI). I've embedded some investor friendly features for tracking your private / public investments via X and other news sources or you can create custom newsletters. Example emails to send marvin@ccmarvin.com: "Send me an email everyday Monday on the top AI stories for the previous week." "Create a newsletter everyday that I get at 7am of what @elonmusk and @sama saying yesterday on X" "Can you track SpaceX, Anthropic, and Google news everyday, send me a portfolio update everday at 6am" Check it out and leave some feedback. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48663022 Points: 3 # Comments: 0
